data.title: Vivy · 海边录下第一首潮声
data.description: 【闭园海滨剧场·午后】Vivy穿着白蓝泳装坐在海边舞台台阶，手持防水录音设备采集潮声；她听完回放后把耳机递向镜头，蓝发在海风里飘动，精确姿态里出现像人类一样的好奇。
data.action: 海边舞台阶梯上录潮声，回放后把防水耳机递给镜头分享
data.lighting: sunlit afternoon with cool ocean reflections
data.mood: 把潮声写进新的幸福记录
data.promptProse: Vivy from Vivy: Fluorite Eye's Song wears a white-and-blue resort swimsuit with a light stage jacket, waterproof earpiece and compact recorder. She sits on the closed seaside theater steps recording the rhythm of the tide. She reviews the first take and offers the waterproof earbud toward the viewer, her long blue hair moving in the breeze as precise curiosity becomes a small human pleasure. sunlit afternoon with cool ocean reflections.
